devFeatures.title: Feature access
devFeatures.description: Choose which screens and features each role or person gets. Switch them on or off here; the server enforces it on every request.
devFeatures.pickUserFirst: Choose a person to see and change their features.
devFeatures.inherits: Also gets everything from their roles: {roles}
devFeatures.appliesNote: Changes apply within seconds, without signing anyone out. Every change is written to the audit log.
devFeatures.screensHint: Switch a whole screen on or off. Turning a screen off removes the permission that opens it, so its data is blocked on the server too.
devFeatures.resetBody: Every on/off change for {name} is removed and the built-in defaults apply again.
devFeatures.resetHint: This cannot be undone, but you can switch things back on afterwards.
devFeatures.confirmBody: These features expose payments, HR, payroll or similar private data. Grant them only if this role or person really needs them.
